profile.headline: Software Engineer • Data Wizard • Tank Driver
profile.summary:
I am an engineer and nonprofit leader with a passion for technology, history, and innovation. My professional experience spans software development, IT systems coordination, and technical training, with a strong focus on building solutions that improve efficiency, safety, and engagement. I am constantly blending engineering with creativity, turning ideas into practical, mission-driven tools.

In past roles, I’ve streamlined user databases, coordinated scheduling and resources to boost productivity, and designed training programs on CNC, fabrication, and industrial equipment that enhanced both safety and performance. I thrive in dynamic environments where collaboration, problem-solving, and continuous learning are essential.

Alongside my technical work, I serve in leadership and operations roles at museums and historical organizations, where I apply data-driven systems to strengthen outreach, volunteer coordination, and public programming. My lifelong interest in aviation, military technology, and preservation inspires both my career path and my volunteer service.

I’m motivated by challenges that require both analytical and creative thinking, and I am eager to contribute to projects that advance technology, strengthen security, and preserve history for future generations.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Created engaging & gesture driven surveys grounded in proven research principles. 
• Managed development of new data evaluation and visualization from scope to completion. 
• Developed and standardized innovative processes and procedures for data visualization and reporting, enhancing analytical insights and operational efficiency.
• Led the management and optimization of data capture systems and report programming, ensuring accuracy and timely delivery of critical data insights.
• Delivered a rapid turnaround on an unexpected project segment, quickly adapting to shifting requirements and ensuring on-time delivery without compromising quality.
• Identified and resolved a critical data defect overlooked by others, preventing inaccurate reporting that would have affected customer success metrics and trust.
• Directed the capture, analysis, and reporting of critical data, employing advanced programming techniques to automate data processes and generate comprehensive, real-time reports for customers. 
• Applied systems thinking to align cross-functional teams, streamline data workflows, and ensure cohesive solutions across complex, multi-phase projects.

positions.title: Front End Developer
positions.description:
• Developed responsive websites and web applications, ensuring they work smoothly on both desktop and mobile devices.
• Utilized HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to build interactive and user-friendly interfaces
Implemented basic security measures to protect user data and privacy.
• Performed routine website testing and debugging to maintain high performance and user satisfaction.
• Adapted web designs based on client feedback, delivering customized solutions that met their business needs.
• Supported new UX/UI development for web and software applications

positions.title: IT / Educator
positions.description:
• Streamlined the User database for accuracy and efficiency, enhancing operational workflows and member satisfaction through data process improvements.
• Coordinated staff and equipment scheduling, optimizing resource use across projects to boost productivity and reduce costs.
• Designed and conducted engaging training sessions on CNC, fabrication, and industrial equipment, elevating safety and productivity through expert instruction.

positions.title: Fashion Historian & Garment Preservation
positions.description: Extensive experience restoring and repairing vintage clothing and textiles.

positions.title: Assistant Director
positions.description: Created a professional and welcoming environment for race teams, track officials, and drivers at the Winner's Circle and at the Podium Celebration.
